Origin and Brief Regulations of the Movable
Dare-to-die Rescue Corps.

Since the "door of peace" having been closed by the Japanese
Imperialists, the Chinese race has offered resistance throughout
the country for emancipation and animosity towards the enemy are
existing among our Chinese people. All the Chinese have decided
to offer their wealths to the Government to support same to resist
the Japanese aggression, as the present war is to calculate the
" Blood Accounts " of ten years with the enemy and is also a "key
of life or death". It is anticipated that there must be a great many
cassulties in the war and in view of this the people at rear ground must
make efforts to supply material assistance and spiritual consolation to
the soldiers, therefore many relief, rescue, and consolation associations
have been duly established to that effect. Being agitated by war-blood,
we are organizing this corps to carry out our dare-to-die works
regardless of our lives for the purpose of fulfilling the duties of
our Chinese people.

------------------
Regulations

1. The purpose of establishing this corps is to carry out relief
and rescue works at front lines, therefore this corps is
entitled the Movable Dare-to-die Rescue Corps in War Zones,
a petition of organizing same having been sent to the General
Control Office of Relief and highest officials for approval.

2. With the approval of the General Control Office of Relief, we
are authorized to use a wooden chop bearing characters of the
Movable Dare-to-die Rescue Corps in War Zones.

3. Armlets and shoulder stripes to be chopped by the Headquarters,
will be distributed to the members for use after inauguration
of the corps. A preparatory office is now established at the
Far Eastern Hospital, 5 Zung Chi Li off Race Course Road, for
the purpose of carrying out registration procedure, and
application will be made to the Headquarters for issuance of
passes, when the members are instructed to make an expedition.

4. Organizers of this corps will prefer to take responsibility of
various expenses by retrenchment of food and clothing, but
charitable organizations and high officials will be requested
to render financial assistance against receipts issued by the
corps, in case of being short of expenditure.

5. Organization:- 1 chairman, to be selected among the members.
2.expert doctors.
1 chemist and others such as nurses, secretary etc.

Groups consisting of above 40 members at least
will be formed for the purpose of carrying out
rescue works, and all the members are required
to make a decision of dare-to-die.

流动敢死救援队的起源及简要章程。

自从日本帝国主义者关闭了“和平之门”，中华民族在全国范围内进行抵抗以求解放，我国人民心中存在着对敌人的仇恨。全体中国人决定向政府捐献财富以支持其抵抗日本侵略，因为当前的战争是与敌人清算十年“血债”之战，也是“生死攸关”的关键。预计战争中必将有许多伤亡，鉴于此，后方民众必须努力向士兵提供物质援助和精神慰藉，因此许多救济、救援和慰问协会应运而生。受战血激荡，我们组建本队，不顾生死开展敢死工作，以履行我们中国人的职责。

------------------
章程

1. 组建本队的目的是在前线开展救济和救援工作，因此本队命名为“战区流动敢死救援队”，组建请愿书已送交救济总管理处及最高官员审批。

2. 经救济总管理处批准，我们获准使用刻有“战区流动敢死救援队”字样的木质印章。

3. 臂章和肩章将由总部加盖印章，在本队成立后分发给队员使用。目前在跑马厅路旁众志里5号远东医院设立筹备处，以办理注册手续，当队员受命出征时，将向总部申请通行证。

4. 本队组织者愿通过节衣缩食承担各项费用，但若支出不足，将凭本队出具的收据请求慈善组织和高官提供财政援助。

5. 组织架构：- 1名主席，从队员中选出。
2名专科医生。
1名药剂师及其他人员，如护士、秘书等。

将组成至少40人的小组以开展
救援工作，所有队员均需作出
敢死的决定。

6. All the members are without pay as they are all patriotic and
enthusiastic, but expenses for food will be supplied if necessary.

7. Wounded soldiers and civilians after being rescued and given
first- aid - treatment by the members and doctors of the corps,
are to be sent to the nearest hospitals without delay.

8. This corps will be dis-solved or altered to hospital at conclusion
of the war.

9. Should any members of the corps fail to obey the laws, they will
be dealt with by Military Authorities according to Military Law.

10. Should any members exert themselves to do their works or be killed
when engaged in works, the chairman of the corps will request
the government and General Control Office of Relief to issue
rewards of compensation for encouragement purpose.

11. These brief regulations can be amended at any time when deficiencies

and fearing that the members might create further trouble removed
all official books and documents belonging to the Corps to Room
